source: frozen AIME26 Qwen3.5-9B teacher-forced trajectories used by QWEN_HADAMARD_FUNCTIONAL_ERROR_GEOMETRY_ANALYSIS_V1
primary_panel: pre-existing clean59, excluding only the previously frozen aime26_28 seed2 pair

injection.site: post recurrent update and post-QDQ state, before recomputed FP-query readout
injection.fp_reference_state: FP branch recurrent state at the same token and layer
injection.identity_error: native INT8 state minus FP state
injection.hadamard_error: Hadamard INT8 state pulled back to native basis minus FP state
injection.common_downstream: FP query, FP gate z, frozen RMSNormGated and out_proj weights; no quantizer/model/scorer changes
injection.interpretation_limit: Observed INT8 state errors include accumulated trajectory differences, not only one-step quantizer noise

local_damage.metric: relative L2 of injected-minus-FP stage output, with denominator max(FP L2,1e-12)
local_damage.secondary: absolute L2, FP denominator distribution and near-zero counts
local_damage.benefit: Identity damage minus Hadamard damage; positive favors Hadamard
local_damage.aggregation: per-trajectory median over all available token-layer observations, then equal-weight clean59 trajectory analysis
local_damage.uncertainty: trajectory bootstrap 95% percentile CI, 10000 fixed-seed resamples
local_damage.paired_test: two-sided paired sign test, zeros excluded and counted
local_damage.group_test: two-sided 10000-permutation rescue versus stable-failure benefit comparison, Cliff's delta, Holm correction across preregistered stages
local_damage.nonfinite: report all counts; never silently remove clean59 rows or select layers/tokens based on outcome

pilot.selection: first frozen clean59 trajectory by canonical index and seed, first 128 generated tokens
pilot.full_logits_feasibility: separate fixed first-trajectory, first-token, first-GDN-layer test of exact downstream logits; report memory, time and parity before any scale-up

output_policy: all new remote files inside this experiment directory; preserve prior artifacts
